grammar.pattern: 都 + 状态 / 数量 + 了
grammar.explanation: 都十点了 highlights lateness in context. 都 refers to the advanced state, not necessarily every object. 都这么晚了 expresses the speaker’s evaluation; verify actual clock time separately.

examples.py: dōu shí diǎn le , xiān jié shù ba .
examples.en: It is already ten; let us stop first.

examples.py: dōu zhè me wǎn le , bié zài děng .
examples.en: It is already so late; do not keep waiting.

examples.zh: 都三天了，还没收到回答。
examples.py: dōu sān tiān le , hái méi shōu dào huí dá .
examples.en: It has already been three days without a reply.

commonMistakes.right: 都十点了强调已经十点，不是钟的数量。
commonMistakes.why: Read the advanced-time use of 都.

grammar.pattern: X 就 X 点儿吧
grammar.explanation: 晚就晚点儿吧 concedes a little lateness rather than claiming lateness never matters. 累就累点儿吧 is language of reluctant acceptance, not advice to ignore exhaustion. This pattern does not override limits, consent or safety.

examples.zh: 晚就晚点儿吧，先告诉她。
examples.py: wǎn jiù wǎn diǎn ér ba , xiān gào sù tā .
examples.en: A little late is acceptable; tell her first.

examples.zh: 少就少点儿吧，别强迫别人。
examples.py: shǎo jiù shǎo diǎn ér ba , bié qiǎng pò bié ren .
examples.en: A little less is acceptable; do not force others.

examples.zh: 慢就慢点儿吧，先说准确。
examples.py: màn jiù màn diǎn ér ba , xiān shuō zhǔn què .
examples.en: A little slower is acceptable; say it accurately first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 慢就慢点儿吧表示必须加快。
commonMistakes.right: 慢就慢点儿吧是接受慢一点，不是要求加快。
commonMistakes.why: The pattern concedes the stated degree.

lines.zh: 都十一点了，我们是不是该走了？
lines.py: dōu shí yī diǎn le , wǒ men shì bú shì gāi zǒu le ?
lines.en: It's already eleven. Shouldn't we get going?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 再坐一会儿吧。我爸退休以后，就喜欢家里热闹。
lines.py: zài zuò yī huì er ba . wǒ bà tuì xiū yǐ hòu , jiù xǐ huān jiā lǐ rè nào .
lines.en: Stay a little longer. Since my dad retired, he loves having people around.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我也想多聊，可明天还要早起。
lines.py: wǒ yě xiǎng duō liáo , kě míng tiān hái yào zǎo qǐ .
lines.en: I'd like to keep talking too, but I have to get up early tomorrow.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我送你到楼下。路上慢一点。
lines.py: nà wǒ sòng nǐ dào lóu xià . lù shàng màn yī diǎn .
lines.en: Then I'll walk you downstairs. Take your time on the way.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 刚才空调开得太冷了，我手指都凉了。
lines.py: gāng cái kōng tiáo kāi dé tài lěng le , wǒ shǒu zhǐ dōu liáng le .
lines.en: The air conditioning was so cold earlier that even my fingers feel cold.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 怪不得你一直抱着杯子。我还以为你特别喜欢那杯水。
lines.py: guài bù dé nǐ yì zhí bào zhe bēi zi . wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ tè bié xǐ huān nà bēi shuǐ .
lines.en: That explains why you kept holding your cup. I thought you really liked that water.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 凉水我怎么会一直想喝啊？
lines.py: liáng shuǐ wǒ zěn me huì yì zhí xiǎng hē a ?
lines.en: Why would I keep wanting cold water?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是我忘了关。下次你直接告诉我。
lines.py: shì wǒ wàng le guān . xià cì nǐ zhí jiē gào sù wǒ .
lines.en: I forgot to turn it off. Tell me directly next time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。对了，周六的聚会我可能晚一点到。
lines.py: hǎo . duì le , zhōu liù de jù huì wǒ kě néng wǎn yī diǎn dào .
lines.en: Okay. By the way, I might arrive a little late on Saturday.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 晚就晚点吧，你来了就好。到时候再聊。
lines.py: wǎn jiù wǎn diǎn ba , nǐ lái le jiù hǎo . dào shí hou zài liáo .
lines.en: A little late is fine. I'm happy as long as you come. We'll talk then.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Respect limits at closing
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 星期五晚上，我们去朋友家给她爸爸庆祝退休。他以前是大夫，工作忙的时候常常很晚才回家。
lines.py: xīng qī wǔ wǎn shang , wǒ men qù péng you jiā gěi tā bà bà qìng zhù tuì xiū . tā yǐ qián shì dà fū , gōng zuò máng de shí hou cháng cháng hěn wǎn cái huí jiā .
lines.en: On Friday evening we visited a friend to celebrate her dad's retirement. He used to be a doctor and often got home very late when work was busy.

lines.zh: 那天他给大家讲以前的事：一次紧急电话、一个多年后又见到的病人，还有一个怕打针的孩子。大家听着听着都笑了。
lines.py: nà tiān tā gěi dà jiā jiǎng yǐ qián de shì : yī cì jǐn jí diàn huà , yī gè duō nián hòu yòu jiàn dào de bìng rén , hái yǒu yī gè pà dǎ zhēn de hái zi . dà jiā tīng zhe tīng zhe dōu xiào le .
lines.en: That evening he told us stories: an urgent phone call, a patient he met again years later, and a child afraid of injections. As we listened, we all started laughing.

lines.zh: 饭后，他拿出照片。最旧的一张已经看不清了，他却还记得照片上每个人的名字。
lines.py: fàn hòu , tā ná chū zhào piān . zuì jiù de yī zhāng yǐ jīng kàn bù qīng le , tā què hái jì de zhào piān shàng měi gè rén de míng zi .
lines.en: After dinner he brought out photographs. The oldest one had faded, but he still remembered everyone in it.

lines.zh: 十一点多，我看了一眼墙上的钟。朋友说明天可以晚起，我却还有早上的课，只好先告别。
lines.py: shí yī diǎn duō , wǒ kàn le yī yǎn qiáng shàng de zhōng . péng you shuō míng tiān kě yǐ wǎn qǐ , wǒ què hái yǒu zǎo shàng de kè , zhǐ hǎo xiān gào bié .
lines.en: After eleven I glanced at the wall clock. My friend said we could get up late the next day, but I had a morning class and had to say goodbye first.

lines.zh: 他送我们到门口，说慢就慢点吧，别急，下次再来。我答应周六带自己做的点心来。
lines.py: tā sòng wǒ men dào mén kǒu , shuō màn jiù màn diǎn ba , bié jí , xià cì zài lái . wǒ dā yìng zhōu liù dài zì jǐ zuò de diǎn xīn lái .
lines.en: He walked us to the door and said to take our time and visit again. I promised to bring homemade snacks on Saturday.

lines.zh: 走到楼下，我才发现外套还在椅子上。都告别两次了，我又得回去一次。朋友打开门，笑着问我是不是又饿了。
lines.py: zǒu dào lóu xià , wǒ cái fā xiàn wài tào hái zài yǐ zi shàng . dōu gào bié liǎng cì le , wǒ yòu dé huí qù yī cì . péng you dǎ kāi mén , xiào zhe wèn wǒ shì bú shì yòu è le .
lines.en: Downstairs I realised my coat was still on a chair. I'd already said goodbye twice, and now I had to go back again. My friend opened the door and laughed, asking if I was hungry again.

questions.q: Why does the narrator return upstairs?
What suggests the host is welcoming?
choices: He invites them back and jokes when the narrator returns
He refuses to open the door
He asks them never to visit again
questions.answer: He invites them back and jokes when the narrator returns

lines.zh: 你怎么又回来了？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me yòu huí lái le ?
lines.en: Why are you back again?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 外套忘了。
lines.py: wài tào wàng le .
lines.en: I forgot my coat.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 都说了三次再见了，这回真的走？
lines.py: dōu shuō le sān cì zài jiàn le , zhè huí zhēn de zǒu ?
lines.en: We've said goodbye three times now. Are you really leaving this time?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 真的。慢就慢点吧，我总会到家的。
lines.py: zhēn de . màn jiù màn diǎn ba , wǒ zǒng huì dào jiā de .
lines.en: Yes. I'll get home eventually, even if I take my time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 等等，你的手机呢？
lines.py: děng děng , nǐ de shǒu jī ne ?
lines.en: Wait. Where's your phone?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 别吓我！在口袋里。
lines.py: bié xià wǒ ! zài kǒu dài lǐ .
lines.en: Don't scare me! It's in my pocket.
lines.speaker: b

lines.en: He received an urgent call and left immediately.

lines.en: The police helped the child find their mum.

lines.zh: 他从河里救了一只狗。
lines.py: tā cóng hé lǐ jiù le yī zhǐ gǒu .
lines.en: He rescued a dog from the river.

lines.zh: 污染会危害人和动物。
lines.py: wū rǎn huì wēi hài rén hé dòng wù .
lines.en: Pollution harms people and animals.

lines.zh: 这家饭馆很注意卫生。
lines.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn hěn zhù yì wèi shēng .
lines.en: This restaurant pays close attention to hygiene.

lines.zh: 卫生间在走廊尽头。
lines.py: wèi shēng jiān zài zǒu láng jìn tóu .
lines.en: The bathroom is at the end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 她看到血就有点害怕。
lines.py: tā kàn dào xuè jiù yǒu diǎn hài pà .
lines.en: She gets a little scared when she sees blood.

lines.zh: 阳台上的花死了，我又种了一棵。
lines.py: yáng tái shàng de huā sǐ le , wǒ yòu zhǒng le yī kē .
lines.en: The plant on the balcony died, so I planted another.

lines.zh: 我爸爸退休以后开始学画画。
lines.py: wǒ bà bà tuì xiū yǐ hòu kāi shǐ xué huà huà .
lines.en: My dad started learning to paint after retiring.

lines.zh: 电影里那对夫妻最后离婚了。
lines.py: diàn yǐng lǐ nà duì fū qī zuì hòu lí hūn le .
lines.en: The couple in the film divorced at the end.

lines.zh: 房间太冷，先把空调关了吧。
lines.py: fáng jiān tài lěng , xiān bǎ kōng tiáo guān le ba .
lines.en: It's too cold in here. Let's turn the air conditioning off.

lines.zh: 杯子里的凉水已经喝完了。
lines.py: bēi zi lǐ de liáng shuǐ yǐ jīng hē wán le .
lines.en: The cool water in the cup has all been drunk.

lines.zh: 她用手指在地图上画了一条路。
lines.py: tā yòng shǒu zhǐ zài dì tú shàng huà le yī tiáo lù .
lines.en: She traced a route on the map with her finger.

lines.zh: 书太重，把盒子压坏了。
lines.py: shū tài zhòng , bǎ hé zi yā huài le .
lines.en: The books were so heavy that they crushed the box.

lines.zh: 墙上的钟比手机快五分钟。
lines.py: qiáng shàng de zhōng bǐ shǒu jī kuài wǔ fēn zhōng .
lines.en: The wall clock is five minutes ahead of the phone.

lines.zh: 她考上了公务员，明年开始上班。
lines.py: tā kǎo shàng le gōng wù yuán , míng nián kāi shǐ shàng bān .
lines.en: She passed the civil-service recruitment exam and starts work next year.

lines.zh: 调查结果出来以后，学校决定延长图书馆的开放时间。
lines.py: diào chá jié guǒ chū lái yǐ hòu , xué xiào jué dìng yán cháng tú shū guǎn de kāi fàng shí jiān .
lines.en: After the survey results came out, the school decided to extend library opening hours.

lines.zh: 老师没有否定我的想法，只让我再改一改。
lines.py: lǎo shī méi yǒu fǒu dìng wǒ de xiǎng fǎ , zhǐ ràng wǒ zài gǎi yī gǎi .
lines.en: The teacher didn’t reject my idea, just asked me to revise it.

lines.zh: 他否认拿过这本书，但我还没找到它。
lines.py: tā fǒu rèn ná guò zhè běn shū , dàn wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào tā .
lines.en: He denies taking this book, but I haven’t found it yet.

lines.zh: 交警站在路口，让车先停下来。
lines.py: jiāo jǐng zhàn zài lù kǒu , ràng chē xiān tíng xià lái .
lines.en: A traffic officer stood at the junction and stopped the cars first.

lines.zh: 我在车站找不到包，就去找警察帮忙。
lines.py: wǒ zài chē zhàn zhǎo bù dào bāo , jiù qù zhǎo jǐng chá bāng máng .
lines.en: I couldn’t find my bag at the station, so I asked the police for help.

lines.zh: 路人把掉进水里的小狗救了上来。
lines.py: lù rén bǎ diào jìn shuǐ lǐ de xiǎo gǒu jiù le shàng lái .
lines.en: A passer-by rescued the puppy that had fallen into the water.

lines.zh: 乱扔垃圾会危害河里的动物。
lines.py: luàn rēng lā jī huì wēi hài hé lǐ de dòng wù .
lines.en: Littering can harm animals in the river.

lines.zh: 卫生间在走廊尽头，左边那扇门。
lines.py: wèi shēng jiān zài zǒu láng jìn tóu , zuǒ biān nà shàn mén .
lines.en: The toilet is at the end of the corridor, through the door on the left.

lines.zh: 他手指破了，流了一点血。
lines.py: tā shǒu zhǐ pò le , liú le yī diǎn xuè .
lines.en: He cut his finger and it bled a little.

lines.zh: 院子里的树死了，我们准备种一棵新的。
lines.py: yuàn zi lǐ de shù sǐ le , wǒ men zhǔn bèi zhǒng yī kē xīn de .
lines.en: The tree in the courtyard died; we plan to plant a new one.

lines.zh: 他们离婚以后，还是一起照顾孩子。
lines.py: tā men lí hūn yǐ hòu , hái shi yì qǐ zhào gù hái zi .
lines.en: After their divorce, they still look after their child together.

lines.zh: 别把书压在眼镜上，会压坏的。
lines.py: bié bǎ shū yā zài yǎn jìng shàng , huì yā huài de .
lines.en: Don’t put books on the glasses; they’ll get crushed.

audio.en: Stay a little longer. Since my dad retired, he loves having people around.

audio.py: xīng qī wǔ wǎn shang , wǒ men qù péng you jiā gěi tā bà bà qìng zhù tuì xiū . tā yǐ qián shì dà fū , gōng zuò máng de shí hou cháng cháng hěn wǎn cái huí jiā .
audio.en: On Friday evening we visited a friend to celebrate her dad's retirement. He used to be a doctor and often got home very late when work was busy.

natural.zh: 今天很开心，我得先走了。

natural.en: I've had a lovely time. I need to get going.

pragmatics.note: Give a warm closing before the reason; 得 signals your need to leave.

natural.zh: 晚就晚点吧，你来了就好。
